key_insight: GraphEP turns cardiac simulations into graph-native learning data and shows that physiology-informed models lead on complementary prediction metrics.
engineering_relevance: The system provides a reproducible pipeline for benchmarking cardiac electrophysiology models on irregular anatomical meshes.
method: Package geometry, tissue properties, stimulation, connectivity, activation targets, and provenance in PyTorch Geometric format.
Compare local message passing, global neural operators, hierarchical graph transformers, and physiology-informed models.
Model activation timing and waveform morphology with HGT-Lag, or evolve excitation and recovery autoregressively with GAP2ODE.
evidence_signal: The benchmark includes 732 left-ventricular simulations across 20 anatomies, with healthy and scarred tissue and multiple pacing configurations; HGT-Lag and GAP2ODE lead on complementary metrics.
watch_item: Performance on simulated left ventricles does not establish generalization to clinical recordings or other cardiac chambers.
paper_title: GraphEP: A Calibrated Data System and Benchmark for Learning Cardiac Electrophysiology
